author: Salem Techsperts
description:
After my last video explaining how the RAM shortage caused by the AI slop industry was making it nearly impossible to source parts for my refurbished laptops, I genuinely didn't expect 1.8 million views and a flood of donations. You guys proved that the community is stronger than the scalpers feeding RAM to the AI goblin.

This video is a massive thank you. Because of your donations, I was able to purchase these devices and make them as future-proof as possible without rewarding the RAM and NVMe scalpers that have become a plague on the second-hand laptop market. My supply is still nowhere near what it was before RAMageddon, and these laptops DID cost me more than normal. But every repairable, reliable, upgradeable laptop I can get into the hands of someone who would've otherwise bought a disposable POS, is a massive W. Thank you all for giving me hope that maybe this year won't be as terrible as it's looking. And more importantly, for contributing to making someones life better.

___
title: RAM Scalpers vs. My Amazing Community

author: Salem Techsperts
description: In the mid 2000’s, most gaming laptops, business laptops, and workstations had socketed CPU’s that could be upgraded. They were thicker and heavier, but much more repairable compared to today!
title: Remember Upgradeable Laptop CPU’s? RIP Dell Vostro #tech #technology #pc #shorts
